LanguageData.LP_LoxodonStature.label: loxodon build
LanguageData.LP_LoxodonStature.description: The tall, heavy build of a loxodon. Actual body size 130% of an ordinary person (carry capacity and caravan load go up, and they're easier to hit at range), drawn at 115% size; hand hauling capacity about 150% of an ordinary person. They eat a bit more too, with a bigger stomach (giant stomach: max food ×130%). The bigger the body, the stronger the health and melee (see giant-body rules: total health ×115%, melee damage ×109%).
LanguageData.LP_LoxodonStature.customEffectDescriptio: Actual body size: ×130% (multiplies with other body size effects).
Hauling capacity: about 150% of an ordinary person (body size ×130% then ×115%).
LanguageData.LP_LoxodonTrunk.label: trunk
LanguageData.LP_LoxodonTrunk.description: A flexible, powerful trunk that replaces the ordinary nose. The trunk works like a third hand: even with both hands hurt, a loxodon can curl things up with the trunk and keep working, and manipulation won't drop below 50%.
LanguageData.LP_LoxodonTrunk.customEffectDescriptions: Third hand: manipulation no lower than 50% (but not above consciousness).
Mutually exclusive with vanilla nose genes and the cow nose.
LanguageData.LP_LoxodonCalm.label: steady
LanguageData.LP_LoxodonCalm.description: Loxodons stay calm and almost never get frightened: they never panic and flee, a lich's fear gaze doesn't work on them, and they're unmoved by horrors like tentacle cloaks. Mind resistance +20%.
Immune to fear-type mental states (panic flee, fear gaze) and the "saw a tentacle cloak" mood.
LanguageData.LP_LoxodonHide.label: thick hide
LanguageData.LP_LoxodonHide.description: A loxodon's skin is thick and tough: blunt armor +10%, sharp armor +5%, and more heat-resistant.
LanguageData.LP_SkinLoxodon.label: elephant grey skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinLoxodon.description: The thick grey skin of a loxodon.
